{{CorrectTitle|title=[Flik'a kirki]}}
'''[Flik'a kirki]''' or '''Virtuous Circle of Nature''' was the central philosophy of [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] nature worship. Ho'Dins believed that they evolved from mobile plants, but they sinned against Nature and were turned into animals. They believed that by acting as stewards of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] flora and environment, they could be reborn as plants, and complete the Virtuous Circle of Nature.
